submitted.rationale: With 2.06 eV illumination, Cu-rich vanadates should absorb best because Cu 3d states narrow the band gap. The three measurements followed the Cu fraction: Cu0.28 (234) gave 5e-8 A, Cu0.53 (74) gave 1.1e-7 A and Cu0.65 (221) gave 2.5e-7 A. Index 221 had the highest measured photocurrent and sits at the Cu-rich edge of the library.

rejected.reason: Measured 1.1e-7 A, lower than 221; sits near the Cu3V2O8 stoichiometry
Measured 5e-8 A; the V-rich CuV2O6-like region performed worst
Not measured; merit budget ran out and the measured trend favoured Cu
